chunks: Al-Sakūnī narrated from Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, from his father عليه السلام:

Regarding a man who freed a bondwoman while she was pregnant, but excluded what was in her womb, he said: "The bondwoman is free, and what is in her womb is free, because what is in her womb is part of her."

key_terms.أَعْتَقَ: manumitted or set free from bondage
key_terms.فَاسْتَثْنَى: then excluded or made an exception of

ai.seo_question: If a man frees a pregnant bondwoman but tries to exclude the child in her womb, is the unborn child also free?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on manumission when a pregnant bondwoman is freed. It states that the child in her womb is also free, because the fetus is regarded here as part of the mother.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3522 - It is narrated by Al-Sakooni, from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) from his father, Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as), peace be upon him, regarding a man who freed a pregnant bondwoman but excluded what was in her womb.
Imam (as) said: "The bondwoman is free, and what is in her womb is also free because what is in her womb is a part of her."
